check.description: Run flake checks and dry-run evaluation
check.template: Run `make check` and `make dry-run`. If `local.nix` or other host-specific prerequisites are missing or invalid, stop and explain what must be fixed before validation can pass.

build.template: Run `make build` for the current host configuration and summarize any evaluation or build failures, including the file most likely responsible.

fmt.description: Format the repo with the configured formatter
fmt.template: Run `make fmt`, report whether files changed, and mention whether follow-up validation such as `make check` or `make build` is recommended.

switch.description: Apply the nix-darwin configuration to this machine
switch.template: Only for explicit apply requests, verify the host-specific configuration is ready and run `make switch`, then summarize the result and any manual follow-up steps.
